descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Dark Ghost' Deep Purple Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Dark Ghost’ is the newest variegated selection from the Ghost Series by Talon Buchholz. The dark purple leaves are darkly reticulated. Fall color can be bright crimson red to bright scarlet red. ‘Dark Ghost’ is new, but we expect it to get 8-10 ft in height in 10 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Dark Ghost' 深紫色网纹斑叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。 ‘Dark Ghost’ 是 Talon Buchholz 的 Ghost Series 中最新选育出的斑叶品种。 叶片呈深紫色，并带有明显的深色网纹。 秋色可转为鲜亮的深红色至猩红色。 ‘Dark Ghost’ 为新品种，但预计 10 年可长至 8-10 英尺高。
